title: Attention-Base deep learning for 3D craniofacial soft tissue landmark detection and diagnosis in orthodontics.
summary: A deep-learning detector localized craniofacial soft-tissue landmarks in orthodontic patients aged 6–18; the study reports landmark errors on its clinic dataset. The result is limited to the evaluated cohort.
